climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, warm summer

land: Slopes face several ways, so growers can pick warmer or cooler spots to suit each grape.

blurb.text: A Loire Valley appellation limited to the commune of Savennières. Its wine is made only from Chenin. The Loire Valley wine region follows the river Loire from the Atlantic coast to near Orléans, with Anjou, Saumur, Chinon and Vouvray in between.
